counting_note: Cube counts are public image/cube artifacts. Source C's 40 image MAT candidates were inferred from the manifest and author script; MAT contents were not opened. Counts do not imply independent biological plants.

sources.dataset_title: Hyperspectral imaging (HS) of tomato leaves inoculated with Botrytis cinerea and Botrytis pseudocinerea
sources.license_status: Verified in current README and DataCite metadata.
sources.access_status: Public metadata, three example calibrated cubes, three example raw-camera archives, and RGB archive; full 904-image experiment available on request per README.
known_limitations: Range is locally verified only for cube 2436; do not transfer its wavelength vector to 2973 or 3079.
Only three cubes are public; they represent three distinct B. pseudocinerea plants.
Processed local plant count is derived from replicate/pathogen/sample identifiers.
Author-provided NPZ calibration provenance remains incomplete.

sources.dataset_title: Hyperspectral imaging (HS) of tomato leaves inoculated with Alternaria protenta
sources.license_status: Verified in current README and DataCite metadata.
sources.access_status: Public metadata, three example calibrated cubes, three example raw-camera archives, and RGB archive; full experiment available on request per README.
known_limitations: The 1000 observation rows are not 1000 cubes; only three NPZ cubes are public.
The three public cubes map to three different plants within a 13-plant experiment.
Metadata schema differs from Source A; isolate and plant identity are combined in the plant field.
Wavelength range and NPZ calibration were not verified because raw archives were not downloaded.
README units/ranges for camera distance and integration time conflict with metadata values or column units.
Alternaria protenta must remain separate from Botrytis labels.

sources.license_status: Verified in Zenodo record API and DataCite metadata; earlier human-readable page display was ambiguous.
sources.access_status: Open Zenodo record with 47 files listed (40 class-named image MAT candidates, 5 feature MAT files, 2 scripts); approximately 6.05 GB total. Image MAT contents were not downloaded or opened.
sources.compatibility_rating: B - Conditionally compatible (separate experiment or external validation)
known_limitations: Eight Botrytis cinerea-named image MAT candidates are listed, but independent plants per file are unknown.
MAT variable image and 550-band structure are MATLAB-script expectations, not verified file headers.
Paper reports days 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, and 11; Zenodo description says days 1, 3, 5, and 7.
Paper reports 25 pots per group; there is no released plant/timepoint mapping for the listed files.
Different cultivar, country, sensor, illumination, and likely radiometry from the TerraSpectra baseline.
Packaged feature workflow uses random image-level splits without plant grouping; potential leakage must be resolved.

sources.license_status: Dataset CC BY 4.0 verified on current Ag Data Commons page and DataCite; article license is separate. Current page is version 2; DataCite v1 metadata describes a different archive size.
sources.access_status: Public version 2 record lists one 15.4 GB ZIP, MD5 77bbf35ab67b8893e66fd68c660905ea; archive not downloaded.
sources.compatibility_rating: B - Conditionally compatible (external bacterial benchmark only)
known_limitations: Bacterial disease, not fungal or Botrytis; keep labels separate.
Paper reports 36 images and 228 leaves, not 228 independent plants.
Paper reports seven days and pathogen population/severity data, but archive-level joins and sample identifiers were not inspected.
Two different sensors/ranges require separate handling; no direct TerraSpectra wavelength alignment.
Version 1 DataCite metadata reports 16531945854 bytes, while current version 2 page lists 15.4 GB.
